entries.title: Psalms 87:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A Song.>> His foundation [is] in the holy mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 87:2
segments: The LORD loves the gates of Zion More than all the dwellings of Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 87:3
segments: Glorious things are spoken of you, O city of God! Selah

entries.title: Psalms 87:4
segments: ¶"I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to those who know Me; Behold, O Philistia and Tyre, with Ethiopia: 'This [one] was born there.'"

entries.title: Psalms 87:5
segments: And of Zion it will be said, "This [one] and that [one] were born in her; And the Most High Himself shall establish her."

entries.title: Psalms 87:6
segments: The LORD will record, When He registers the peoples: "This [one] was born there." Selah

entries.title: Psalms 87:7
segments: Both the singers and the players on instruments [say], "All my springs [are] in you."
